summary: All six criteria are met. The default profile declares budgets.bundleBytes as an empty map. bundleSizeCheck fails over-cap files with file, size and cap in the details, passes at or under cap, skips on an empty or absent map, and skips missing files while listing them, without hiding another file that is over its cap. The new test covers all four cases. docs/rules.md has a preflight row with an evidence column. Changes stay inside the declared paths. I ran npm test (82 of 82 pass) and npm run check (10 passed, 0 failed). No secrets or English problems.

findings.issue: The pass case is asserted only with a file exactly at its cap. A strictly under-cap file takes the same branch, so the gap is low risk.

a file over its cap fails and the details name file, size and cap
